subject: control of number of columns displayed

messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: control of number of columns displayed
parts:
Hi,
Is there a way to control how many columns to display with tbl_df in dplyr?
I am using R studio and rmarkdown to generate and html document but my tables are only
displaying only 7 columns even though I still have space for a few more to the right of the box.
 
# Using the hflights dataset to Reproduce what I am talking about.
library(dplyr)
hflights_df <- tbl_df(hflights)
hflights_df

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: control of number of columns displayed
parts:
You can use the knitr chunk option width to set the width.
Hadley
